description: Create a new calendar event on the signed-in user's default calendar. Returns the created event with its `id`, `webLink`, and (if attendees are present) an auto-generated online-meeting URL — attendees receive invitations on save. Times use the configured timezone (default Australia/Melbourne; override with `OUTLOOK_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE`); omit the `Z` suffix to send local time. Use `manage-event` action=`update` to modify an event after creation, or `manage-event` action=`cancel`/`delete` to remove it.

body.description: Optional body content for the event

end.description: The end time of the event in ISO 8601 format

start.description: The start time of the event in ISO 8601 format

name: create-event
